title: How Much, Then Where: Credit-Conserving Action-to-Token Allocation for Multi-Turn Agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 多少、然后到哪：面向多轮 Agent 强化学习的保信用 Action-to-Token 分配
abstract_en: Credit assignment in multi-turn agent reinforcement learning operates at two levels: assigning trajectory-level credit to actions and distributing each action's credit across its tokens. In this paper, we introduce FACTOR, which separates these decisions. FACTOR uses checkpoint-calibrated TD residuals to assign per-action credits that telescope to the trajectory advantage, and feedback-conditioned teacher-student likelihood gaps to allocate each credit across the realized action tokens. Per-action normalization preserves the action-average coefficient and prevents token-level sign flips. We pair this construction with an action-mean reduction, removing the implicit dependence of an action's scalar surrogate weight on its token length. At the behavior policy and before clipping, each action's inner action-mean surrogate equals its TD credit. FACTOR consistently improves over competitive baselines across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, with every environment-seed comparison favoring FACTOR and the largest gains emerging on the longest-horizon environment. The same hyperparameters transfer without retuning to a larger backbone and to a different model family. Ablations identify TD action credit as the dominant driver of the improvement, with hindsight token allocation contributing complementary gains.
abstract_zh: 本文研究多轮 Agent 强化学习中的 credit assignment 问题：既要把轨迹级信用分配给各个 action，也要把每个 action 的信用进一步分配到其生成的 token 上。作者提出 FACTOR，将这两个决策解耦。FACTOR 使用经过 checkpoint 校准的 TD residuals 为每个 action 分配信用，并保证这些 action 信用可望远镜式相加为整体 trajectory advantage；随后利用基于反馈条件的 teacher-student likelihood gaps，将每个 action 的信用分配到实际生成的 action tokens 上。其 per-action normalization 保持 action-average 系数并避免 token 级符号翻转；同时采用 action-mean reduction，消除 action 的标量 surrogate 权重对 token 长度的隐式依赖。在 behavior policy 且 clipping 之前，每个 action 的内部 action-mean surrogate 等于其 TD credit。实验表明，FACTOR 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上稳定优于强基线，所有 environment-seed 对比均支持 FACTOR，并且在最长视野任务上收益最大。相同超参数还能无须重新调参迁移到更大的 backbone 和不同模型家族。消融显示，TD action credit 是性能提升的主要来源，而 hindsight token allocation 提供互补增益。
key_points_zh: 提出 FACTOR，将多轮 Agent RL 中的 action-level credit assignment 与 token-level credit allocation 解耦处理。
使用 checkpoint-calibrated TD residuals 分配 per-action credits，并保证其总和与 trajectory advantage 一致。
通过 feedback-conditioned teacher-student likelihood gaps 将 action 信用分配到已生成 tokens，同时用 per-action normalization 避免 token 级符号翻转。
引入 action-mean reduction，去除 surrogate 权重对 action token 长度的隐式依赖，使 behavior policy 下 action-mean surrogate 等于 TD credit。
在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 上全面优于强基线；超参数可迁移到更大 backbone 和不同模型家族，消融表明 TD action credit 是主要贡献。

llm_assessment.comment: FACTOR targets a central bottleneck in multi-turn agent RL by cleanly separating action-level and token-level credit allocation.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: FACTOR 针对多轮智能体强化学习的核心瓶颈，将动作级与 token 级信用分配清晰分离。
